title: NikoMood - Functional app for mood tracking
description: NikoMood is an app that tracks and records mood changes. It helps identify patterns and factors that influence emotions, and offers interactive graphical analysis and AI-based summaries for valuable insights into mental well-being.
about: I built this app with my team at AgileTeknik over approximately 6 months, taking it to the minimum marketable product (MMP) stage. I worked on it as a mobile developer. My contributions include:
about_list: Managed gradual, iterative releases of the app on the Google Play Store.
Internationalized the app for international users.
Added advertising features to generate revenue.
Sliced UI designs into code for several feature updates.
project_results: This app has been well received by 200+ users, with reviews and feedback praising its ease of use and effectiveness in tracking mood changes. Results while I was on the project:
project_results_list: Used by 200+ users on the Google Play Store.
Gathered reviews and feedback to guide new features.
Earned revenue during development through advertising features.
Applied design patterns to keep the codebase maintainable for continued development.
